title: Fleet Runner result row (schema 1)
description: Posted to /results. kind=result rows are idempotent by (job_id, device_id, iter). kind=beacon rows are telemetry samples, also posted during host-driven jobs.

job_id.description: required for kind=result; optional for beacon samples

iter.description: iteration number; use 0 for single-shot results and the summary row

final.description: marks the job finished on this device

metrics.description:
Workload metrics; memory is labeled, never laundered.

Every field here means one thing. Before the vision-eval and drain fields existed, those workloads reused the LLM slots — vision put top-1 accuracy in decode_tok_s, p50 latency in ttft_ms and images/sec in prefill_tok_s; drain put percent-per-hour in decode_tok_s — and top-5 and p95 had nowhere to go at all, so they were only ever in the hand-written eval report. Rows predating these fields still carry that convention, and the dashboard marks anything it had to infer that way. New runners must populate the named fields instead.

top1_pct.description: vision-eval: top-1 accuracy over the eval set

top5_pct.description: vision-eval: top-5 accuracy over the eval set

drain_pct_per_h.description: drain: battery percent consumed per hour

diff_pct.description: web-shots: percent of pixels differing from the accepted baseline (100 when the dimensions changed)

issues_error.description: web-audit/web-unfurl: error-severity findings (these fail the run)

issues_warn.description: web-audit/web-unfurl: warn-severity findings (recorded, never fail the run)

clicks.description: archive(gsc): total clicks for the archived day

impressions.description: archive(gsc): total impressions for the archived day

reviews_count.description: archive(asc/play) and digest: reviews pulled / digested

avg_rating.description: archive(asc/play) and digest: mean star rating over those reviews

clusters.description: digest: topic clusters in the assembled digest

artifacts.description: sha256 refs of output artifacts the runner uploaded (batch outputs, reports)
sha256 refs of screenshots/videos/junit uploaded to the artifact store

shot.description: web-shots per-page rows: which cell of the visual matrix this row judges. The dashboard grid is assembled from these — never from iter order, which maps to manifest order and changes when the manifest does.

sha256.description: the captured shot; absent when capture failed

diff_sha256.description: the diff image; present only when the page diverged past threshold
